A '''hoverbike''' was a type of [[speeder bike]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], several [[Youngling|children]] on [[At Attin]] owned hoverbikes. Some models could seat only one being, the pilot,<ref name="WimNeel">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/6qc2t7j74v3ngqkz497rvw|text=GR-052549 R|date=2024-08-05}}</ref> while others could also carry one passenger.<ref name="FernKB" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==History==
Around [[9 ABY]]<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref>, many [[Youngling|children]] living in a [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] on the remote [[planet]] of [[At Attin]] owned and rode hoverbikes for recreation. Some, like [[Fern]] and [[Bonjj Phalfa]], raced [[Fern and KB's hoverbike|their]] [[Bonjj Phalfa's hoverbike|bikes]] against one another for sport. The vehicles could seat two and three beings, respectively.<ref name="Real Adventure">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref>

The human boy [[Wim]] rode [[Wim's hoverbike|his bike]] in an effort to make it to [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|school]] after oversleeping and missing the [[School tram|tram]], but ultimately crashed in the woods. His friend [[Neel]] also [[Neel's hoverbike|owned one]]. Both could only seat a single being.<ref name="Real Adventure" />
